scripts.build: bun run build:browser-tools && bun run build:ui
scripts.typecheck: bun run typecheck:browser-tools && bun run typecheck:ui && bun run typecheck:job
scripts.test: bun run test:server && bun run test:ui && bun test packages/browser-tools tests/openlia_job.test.ts
scripts.format: biome format --write packages tests/openlia_job.test.ts package.json tsconfig.base.json tsconfig.job.json biome.json
scripts.format:check: biome format packages tests/openlia_job.test.ts package.json tsconfig.base.json tsconfig.job.json biome.json
scripts.lint: biome lint packages tests/openlia_job.test.ts package.json tsconfig.base.json tsconfig.job.json
scripts.check: bun run format:check && bun run lint && bun run typecheck
scripts.verify-dist: bun run build && test -s packages/browser-tools/dist/server.js && test -s packages/workspace-ui/dist/server.js && test -s packages/workspace-ui/dist/public/index.html
